observations.detail: The treatment preserves employer proof burden and FLSA-exempt coverage, teacher threshold and educational establishments, outside-classroom work, and aircrew reference. Its separate teacher requirement omits when accurate hours records are not maintained. That condition is present in the control teacher meaning and source paragraph. Selecting all of F000 as evidence does not restore it in explicit meaning.

observations.assessment: principal meanings retained; modal uncertainty remains
observations.detail: Both retain leave-start timing and the conditional FMLA transition. Both label the non-FMLA circumstance permission; this is a known descriptive-versus-permission concern rather than new evidence of improved classification.

observations.assessment: alternatives and thresholds retained; kind discrepancy
observations.detail: Treatment retains nonconsecutive employment with proviso, seven years or more versus more than seven, both USERRA and written-rehire routes, USERRA absence credit and entitlement limit. The counting exemption is labeled permission instead of exemption, despite explicit need not in meaning. Governing passages are substantive and do not introduce the nearby worksite/payroll conditions.

observations.assessment: no demonstrated grounding improvement in paired cases
observations.detail: All six inventories have valid evidence; neither control reproduces the earlier bare-marker failures. Treatment locations are deterministic, but no treatment benefit in rejected-entry counts is established by these excerpts.
